questions.q: Before Jesus ascended, He gave the disciples a specific instruction in Luke 24:49 regarding their empowerment for ministry. What were they supposed to do?
options: Go immediately to Rome and confront the Emperor.
Stay in the city until they were clothed with power from on high.
Disband and return to their fishing businesses.
Move into the wilderness and build a permanent tabernacle.
questions.explain: Jesus emphasized the absolute necessity of the Holy Spirit's empowerment, saying: "And behold, I am sending the promise of my Father upon you. But stay in the city until you are clothed with power from on high."
